claim_boundary: Outputs rank numerical screening directions only. No conservation, independence, involution, or integrability claim is made.

provenance.holdout_policy: The upstream holdout was already executed for WP1Q-N3BP-v1 and is excluded from WP3 exploration. It is not represented as a fresh WP3 publication holdout. A separately sealed WP3 holdout is required by the publication gate.

search.dimensional_policy: Search each mass-length-time dimension sector independently. Coefficients from different physical dimensions are never combined.
